### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | Yes — JoCN-specific policy supplementing MIT Press Journal Publication Ethics |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | Conditional — permitted for language/clarity editing (author-verified) and synthetic/simulated data for methodological development (e.g. algorithm testing); prohibited for generating primary research data (incl. synthetic neuroimaging fMRI/EEG/MEG/fNIRS or fabricated statistical output) or unsupervised generation of substantive research content; agentic AI used for research tasks (e.g. code, data pipelines) must be disclosed in Methods with tool/model name |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | JoCN-specific AI policy (supplements MIT Press default): AI cannot be listed as author; author fully responsible for AI-assisted content; permitted uses limited to text polishing and synthetic data for method development; hard prohibition on AI-generated primary data/images and unsupervised substantive content generation; reviewers discouraged from using AI to evaluate manuscript science but may use it to polish review text, with mandatory disclosure visible only to the handling editor. |
| **Source URL** | https://direct.mit.edu/jocn/pages/submission-guidelines |

## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from publisher-disclosed practices (direct.mit.edu/jocn submission guidelines) and Wikipedia editorial information gathered 2026-05. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. ### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High — international cognitive-neuroscience authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium — accepts non-Western data within cognitive-neuroscience empirical framework |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium-High — neurodiversity, developmental neuroscience papers published |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Cognitive neuroscience — cross-disciplinary scope: neuroscience, neuropsychology, cognitive psychology, neurobiology, linguistics, computer science, philosophy. Neural/behavioral (1,890 articles), neural dynamics (1,351), visual perception (1,046), memory/neural (790), language/bilingualism (774), EEG/BCI (572) per OpenAlex |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **cognitive-neuroscience contribution** at the intersection of brain and cognition. Preregistered Research Reports option available: Stage 1 in-principle accept based on question importance + method rigor (not "liking" results) → Stage 2 publication guarantee.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts without neural / brain measurement redirected; pure behavioral cognitive psychology better suited to dedicated cognitive venues.

| Mixed methods | 2 | Accepted with quantitative-neural dominance |

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers drawn primarily from the cognitive neuroscience community — Cognitive Neuroscience Society faculty and senior researchers across neuroimaging, neuropsychology, computational neuroscience, and adjacent subfields. EIC Bradley R. Postle (Wisconsin–Madison) provides editorial direction. Cross-disciplinary tolerance — neuroscience, neuropsychology, cognitive psychology, neurobiology, linguistics, CS, philosophy all welcomed. Stage 1 preregistered review focuses on question importance and method rigor (anti-bias mechanism: not "liking" results).

### AI-Research Notes (supplementary AI research, 2026-07-13)

> Added as a **supplementary, independent research pass** — it does NOT overwrite or supersede the Tier assessment above. Treat conflicts as a signal to re-verify, not as an automatic correction. Overall `signal_quality` for this pass: **4/5**.

**AI-research finding (policy):** JoCN 有專屬 AI 政策(補充 MIT Press 出版倫理)。禁止 AI 掛名作者。允許用途:潤飾文字語言(需作者驗證)、生成模擬/合成資料做方法學開發(如測試演算法)、產生「卡通式」示意圖。禁止用途:產生主要研究資料(含合成神經影像 fMRI/EEG/MEG/fNIRS 或捏造統計輸出)、在無人類監督下生成實質研究內容/假設/詮釋、產生不直接代表研究資料的圖像。若 agentic AI 自主/半自主執行研究任務(如寫程式碼、管理資料流程),須在 Methods 章節以與其他方法同等細節揭露所用工具與模型名稱(如 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet)及其邏輯目的,並鼓勵公開 prompt 與 AI 生成的程式碼。作者對全文(含 AI 輔助部分)之準確性、完整性、原創性負完全責任。審稿人被強烈勸阻使用 AI 分析/評估稿件科學內容(擔心機密外洩與偏見放大),但可用 AI 潤飾審稿意見文字;送出審稿意見時系統會詢問是否使用 AI,若答「是」則後續問題答案僅編輯可見、作者不可見。定性為 conditional gate(允許但有明確邊界與揭露義務),寬鬆度中等偏嚴(3/5:非全面禁止,但對「實質內容生成」與「主要資料生成」設有硬性紅線)。

**AI-research finding (positioning — what the journal accepts now):** 2026 年出刊(Vol.38)近期文章涵蓋:睡眠與認知(phase dynamics/thought-behavior bridge)、創造力任務的功能腦網絡連結(fMRI)、詞形/正字法/語意促發之 ERP 比較研究、視覺工作記憶在眼動後的皮質表徵(fMRI)。整體仍以嚴謹實證腦-行為研究(fMRI/EEG/MEG/ERP/NHP 電生理等)為主軸,強調方法學透明度(樣本量、效應量、貝氏統計)。未查到 2026 年度特刊/CFP。

**AI-research finding (experiential):** LetPub 網友評分(50人):聲譽 7.6、影響力 5.3、速度 9.4(滿分10,速度偏快)。網友分享『平均錄取比例』標示為『較難』;唯一可見具體留言(2016年,近期更新於2024)稱『比較容易，審稿也挺快的，不錯！』。SciRev 僅2筆評論,其一為『編輯與3位審稿人中2位表現優異』但1位審稿人拖延且審查草率後退出,最終『Accepted』,整體流程評4/5→3/5(good process)。

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without neural / brain measurement (consider Cognition, JEP:General for behavioral-only cognitive work)
- Pure qualitative submissions
- AI-generated images per MIT Press policy
- Failure to disclose AI use

### Soft Tax

Low for cognitive-neuroscience tradition authors. Preregistered Research Reports option (Stage 1 → Stage 2 guarantee) opens space for replication and theory-test work without publication-bias pressure (community evidence: JoCN submission guidelines 2026-05). Impact Factor ~2.71 — moderate prestige in cognitive-neuroscience space.

### Best Suited For

- Cognitive neuroscience empirical studies (fMRI, EEG, MEG, behavioral-neural)
- Memory, perception, language, attention neuroscience research
- Preregistered Research Reports for replication / theory-test work
- Cross-disciplinary brain-cognition bridging studies
- Computational cognitive neuroscience
- Neuropsychology and neurological-population research

### Not Recommended For

- Pure behavioral cognitive psychology without neural measurement (consider Cognition)
- Pure clinical neuroscience without cognitive framing
- Autoethnography or first-person work
- Authors needing rapid OA visibility (MIT Press publishing model)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Cognition](./cognition.md) | If recast as behavioral cognitive work; Elsevier; broader cognitive-psychology scope |
| 2 | [Trends in Cognitive Sciences](./trends-in-cognitive-sciences.md) | If reframed as theoretical synthesis (pre-submission proposal track); Cell Press |
| 3 | [Journal of Experimental Psychology General](../psychology/journal-of-experimental-psychology-general.md) | If general-cognitive empirical without neural measurement |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top cognitive-psychology venue as "too neural-focused," JoCN is often a better fit because: it specializes in cognitive-neuroscience bridging studies; Preregistered Research Reports option provides publication-bias-resistant track; and Cognitive Neuroscience Society affiliation provides built-in audience.
